objections: two divisions have not assigned component budget ownership
purchase signatory unknown and funding request absent
no technical supplier credibility or performance concern
label: qualify_budget_authority
label_rationale: A seven-week production need is established, but budget ownership and the person authorized to purchase remain unresolved.

narrative: A large exporter of automated washing equipment is negotiating replacement flow sensors because its incumbent's deliveries are unreliable. The buyer requests a ten percent reduction while our salesperson can approve six percent. However, the customer's engineer has just added a hotter cleaning cycle that was absent from the accepted specification. An older email says the original temperature still applies, and engineering has not established which revision governs the purchase. The correct cycle record can be provided electronically. Funding and purchase authority are confirmed, but technical compatibility is now unresolved. The buyer also mentions a supplier portal redesign. The commercial discussion has continued even though the two temperature records remain inconsistent.
pain_points: incumbent deliveries unreliable
funding and purchase authority confirmed
objections: new hotter cycle conflicts with previously accepted temperature
governing revision and technical compatibility unresolved with records available electronically
required discount 10 percent versus sales authority 6 percent
label: request_spec_review
label_rationale: The conflicting cleaning-cycle revisions reopen technical suitability, so price is not yet the sole remaining barrier.

meta.ambiguity: Escalate_pricing is plausible from the buyer's discount request, but the reopened technical requirement takes priority until the governing revision is established.

narrative: A medium domestic manufacturer of ceramic tile handling machines has accepted our sensor specifications and proposal terms as an alternative to its incumbent's delayed parts. A quality email calls our brand unproven, while the engineering lead clarifies that the supplier paperwork and relevant industry experience are already accepted. The unresolved issue is detection consistency during dusty shifts on the customer's own line. The quality manager agrees that there is no company admission restriction, but has not withdrawn the earlier wording. Funds, a separate production cell, and authority for a limited quantity are available. Management will not approve a full change without operating evidence. The company's upcoming trade fair occupies several unrelated messages in the email thread.
pain_points: incumbent delays
specifications terms credentials and relevant industry experience accepted
funds separate cell and limited quantity authority available
objections: quality email calls brand unproven but clarification concerns dusty shift detection
no supplier admission restriction
full change withheld pending own line operating evidence
label: propose_pilot_order
label_rationale: Clarification establishes accepted supplier credibility and specifications, leaving product consistency on the customer's own line as the unresolved risk.

meta.ambiguity: Send_case_study is plausible from the phrase unproven brand, but later clarification locates the concern in product performance on the customer's line.

narrative: A large exporter of battery handling machinery wants an alternative to its incumbent sensor supplier and has accepted our technical specification, price, and delivery. Procurement describes the barrier as reliability and an engineer mentions checking our units on equipment. The operations director clarifies that no parameter or measured performance is disputed; management doubts whether our company has supported other battery machinery businesses over time. She will not release machine time or funds for product evaluation until that experience concern is addressed. General company documents are accepted, and no compulsory physical supplier audit applies. The annual purchasing budget exists. An unrelated email discusses changing the format of visitor badges at the customer's headquarters.
pain_points: incumbent alternative sought
specification price delivery and general company documents accepted
annual budget exists
objections: reliability wording clarified as doubt about battery machinery sector support history
equipment time and evaluation funds blocked until experience concern resolved
no disputed performance parameter or compulsory physical audit
label: send_case_study
label_rationale: The decision maker identifies sector support history as the prerequisite for releasing evaluation resources, rather than uncertainty about a measured product parameter.

meta.ambiguity: Propose_pilot_order is plausible from the engineer's equipment comment, but management requires relevant supplier experience to be established first.

narrative: A medium domestic maker of sheet feeding machinery has no incumbent for a new thickness sensor package. Specifications, budget, price, and delivery are accepted. Purchasing says our supplier entry documents are complete and believes an order can proceed. A newer message from the quality head states that the final admission signature depends on witnessing our calibration handling at the factory; uploaded certificates satisfy only the preliminary requirement. The quality head owns admission authority and confirms that the physical requirement remains mandatory. Purchasing has not yet updated its internal checklist. There is no open product performance concern. The customer recently changed courier providers, which accounts for several irrelevant delivery-address messages in the same thread.
pain_points: new thickness sensing package with specifications budget price and delivery accepted
objections: purchasing claims entry complete but admission owner requires factory calibration observation
certificates only satisfy preliminary requirement and physical requirement mandatory
no unresolved product performance concern
label: schedule_site_visit
label_rationale: The admission authority's newer statement confirms a mandatory physical calibration assessment despite purchasing's outdated completion claim.

meta.ambiguity: Request_spec_review could seem sufficient from purchasing's paperwork account, but the responsible quality authority explicitly requires physical observation.

narrative: A large domestic maker of industrial fans is assessing us as an additional vibration sensor supplier alongside its incumbent. Engineering and quality approvals have already been completed outside the sales system, whose record still shows purchasing assessment. The buyer confirms an annual requirement of 22,000 units and accepts warranty, payment, and delivery. A thirteen percent reduction is required to meet the approved component allowance, while our salesperson can authorize five percent. The buyer explicitly identifies price as the only open issue and has authority to award the order once it is resolved. The customer also requests its new billing address on the paperwork because the administrative office moved across the street.
pain_points: annual demand 22000 units with buyer award authority
technical quality warranty payment and delivery approval complete despite early sales record
objections: required discount 13 percent versus sales authority 5 percent
price is sole unresolved condition
label: escalate_pricing
label_rationale: Completed technical and supplier approvals leave only a thirteen percent discount request beyond the salesperson's five percent authority.

narrative: A medium exporter of automated sewing equipment has no sensor supplier for a planned thread monitoring feature. A sales engineer's old note says launch timing is urgent. This week, the programme director and purchasing head jointly confirm that the feature is deferred for fifteen months and that no parts or evaluation expenditure will be authorized beforehand. Our published specification fits, and no permanent commercial restriction prevents future business. The engineer acknowledges the new schedule but continues using the old email subject marked urgent. The account also contains a request for an updated company logo for a future supplier directory. No current project, exception budget, or replacement demand has been identified by either responsible manager.
pain_points: future thread monitoring feature fits published specification
no permanent commercial restriction
objections: old urgent note superseded by director and purchasing confirmation of fifteen month deferral
no parts or evaluation expenditure before restart
no current project exception budget or replacement demand
label: nurture
label_rationale: Both responsible managers have superseded the old urgency note with a confirmed fifteen-month deferral and no interim purchasing activity.

meta.ambiguity: Qualify_budget_authority is plausible if the old urgency note is treated as current, but its author acknowledges the authoritative updated schedule.

narrative: A small exporter of enclosed mixing machines wants an alternative to its incumbent level sensor. Its end customer's signed procurement specification requires independent hygienic certification for every wetted sensor assembly. Our applicable products have no such certification, and our product team confirms that no certification programme or certified alternative is available. The buyer has checked with the end customer, which will not accept a declaration from the manufacturer or change the requirement. Budget and volume are otherwise suitable. The end customer included this requirement when the machine design was approved, and procurement has no discretion to waive it. The contact also mentions a preferred carton colour and the date of the firm's annual stock count.
pain_points: incumbent alternative sought with suitable budget and volume
signed customer contract requires independent hygienic certification
objections: all applicable products lack required certification
no certification programme or certified alternative
end customer rejects declaration substitution and requirement changes
label: disqualify
label_rationale: The non-waivable contractual certification is absent from all applicable products, with no certified alternative or programme to close the gap.
